name: Time Series Analysis & Forecasting
description: Decomposition, stationarity, classical statistical models, tree-based lag engineering, and deep temporal architectures.

subskills.name: Time Series Decomposition & Additive/Multiplicative Components
subskills.description: Decomposing temporal signals into trend, seasonal, cyclical, and irregular/noise components using classical and STL decomposition.

subskills.name: Stationarity Transformations & Unit Root Testing (ADF, KPSS)
subskills.description: Checking covariance stationarity, Augmented Dickey-Fuller (ADF) test, KPSS test, fractional differencing, and Box-Cox transforms.

subskills.name: Statistical Univariate Forecasting (ARIMA, SARIMA, Auto-ARIMA)
subskills.description: Autoregressive (AR), Moving Average (MA), seasonal integration (SARIMA), ACF/PACF interpretation, and Box-Jenkins methodology.

subskills.name: Exponential Smoothing & State Space Models (Holt-Winters, ETS)
subskills.description: Simple Exponential Smoothing (SES), Holt's linear trend, Holt-Winters seasonal exponential smoothing, and ETS state space formulation.

subskills.name: Tree-Based Forecasting & Lag/Rolling Feature Engineering
subskills.description: Autoregressive lag creation, rolling mean/std/min/max windows, expanding features, cyclical calendar encodings with LightGBM/XGBoost.

subskills.name: Sequential Neural Forecasting (LSTM, GRU, TCN, N-BEATS)
subskills.description: Recurrent architectures for temporal modeling, Temporal Convolutional Networks (dilated causal convolutions), and N-BEATS basis expansions.

subskills.name: Transformer Forecasting Architectures (TFT, PatchTST, Informer)
subskills.description: Self-attention on time series, Temporal Fusion Transformer for static/dynamic metadata gating, PatchTST channel independence.

subskills.name: Temporal Validation & Backtesting Strategies (TimeSeriesSplit)
subskills.description: Preventing future data leakage with TimeSeriesSplit, rolling origin evaluation, blocked cross-validation, and expanding window backtesting.

subskills.name: Forecast Accuracy Metrics & Diagnostics (MAPE, WAPE, Pinball)
subskills.description: Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), symmetric MAPE, Weighted Absolute Percentage Error (WAPE), MASE, and Pinball loss for quantiles.

github.signal: Uses statsmodels or prophet for time series analysis
Implements neural or lag-based time series pipelines with TimeSeriesSplit
